args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the target** — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy; v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).
3. **Rolled back** — deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions; rollback verified.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** — `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the target** — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy; v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).
3. **Rolled back** — deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions; rollback verified.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** — `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
